en: Probably...
Plans must be laid meticulously, and then
executed with precision.
That, for our nation and our army's victory,
is the shortest road of all.
My days are spent on nothing but war.
For a man like me, with no family of his own,
my men are like my own children.
My men, like my own sons, clutch their guts
and beg for help, but I leave them and go on.
That is the law of war.

en: <You're not heartless>
Coming from someone like you,
I hardly expected such an answer.
It's precisely because we know it's heartless
that wars come to an end.
But that end is only ever temporary...
That's just the answer I'd expect from you.
But that thinking is far too dangerous.
Even war has its bare minimum of rules.
It's a view that could even become an excuse
for those who break those rules.
As long as there is war in this world,
victory alone is my duty.
I've told you often enough that civilians
aren't allowed in. You don't seem to get it.
note: Shared by msgs 91348 and 92012; 'get it' set up for the reply #2349 'No, I don't.'

you people have for keeping others out
apply to me.
So you're no enemy spy,

en: You underestimate me.
I'm saying if you'll do it, then do it quickly.
But do it to me alone.
Leave my men alone.
You know as well as I do
that stopping because you're told to
isn't the law of war...
A wise choice. A gentle sort like you
just wouldn't make it as a soldier anyway.
A delicate fellow like you is hardly
cut out to be a soldier, I'd say.
Do you want to join the navy?
Without any reason... I see.
(But I have a reason for drinking blood.)
<You are heartless>
note: Answer choice (polite Christopher version); answered by #2378

en: <It can't be helped>
Just the answer I'd expect from you.
A wise answer.
If you don't know where to keep a cool head,
your losses will never grow any fewer.
Only when it rests on cool judgment
does compassion take on any meaning.
So you'd noticed...
It wasn't tonight that told me, but your
conduct during the day.
Hardly anyone comes to me without
wanting to enlist, after all.
By day you looked delicate,
but seeing you like this, at night,
I understand the position I'm in.
Only for a short while, at night. That's all.
I would like you to lend me your strength.
I won't ask why you fight.
Can you win?
That's why I approached you.
Very well. Do it.
Quickly, before I change my mind!
As you command...
